reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read Matthew's begat loosely, noting the genealogy deliberately skips Ahaziah, Joash and Amaziah to keep the fourteen-generation pattern.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the flat count: Matthew names Joram as Uzziah's father, though Chronicles places three kings, Ahaziah, Joash and Amaziah, between them.

sides.snippet: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
sides.verseText: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

sides.snippet: Joram became the father of Uzziah.
sides.verseText: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
